categories.scope: Only candidates this request inspected (provider windows). Not a whole-chain census. Categories never change ranking.

qualified.label: Qualified Discovery
qualified.basis: passed every Radar gate and cross-check

emerging.label: Emerging Projects
emerging.basis: pool younger than 24h; provider-reported only; not ranked

momentumWatch.label: Momentum Watch
momentumWatch.basis: observed movement only; not a safety or buy signal

lowLiquidityHighRisk.label: Low Liquidity / High Risk
lowLiquidityHighRisk.basis: verified liquidity below the network floor

insufficientEvidence.label: Insufficient Evidence
insufficientEvidence.basis: key fields missing or sources disagree

anomalyLegend.DUPLICATE_TICKER_IN_WINDOW: Same ticker as another contract in this window
anomalyLegend.FEW_WALLETS_MANY_TRADES: Few distinct wallets for many trades (possible wash trading)
anomalyLegend.ONE_SIDED_FLOW: Almost all trades are on one side

newPools.label: New Pools (on-chain)
newPools.basis: Pools discovered from on-chain creation events. Discovery is not a safety or quality signal; unreviewed factories are labelled.

sources.label: CoinGecko Onchain / GeckoTerminal
sources.role: ranking: top pools by 24h volume; newest pools

sources.label: DEX Screener
sources.role: independent cross-check of price, volume, liquidity, change and pool age for the exact contract

statusLegend.CROSS_VERIFIED: Two independent indexers agree within tolerance.
statusLegend.SOURCE_REPORTED: One provider reports it; not independently cross-checked.
statusLegend.NOT_VERIFIED: Missing or contradicting; shown as N/A.
statusLegend.ONCHAIN_VERIFIED: Read directly from the official pons factory contract.

opportunity.policy: Snapshot computed outside visitor requests; served without a live provider call. V6 target up to 40 evidence-qualified rows per network; never padded. Legacy snapshots remain capped at 10.
